newsitem.title: UK: Dry cargo freight rates ease again.
newsitem.headline: Dry cargo freight rates ease again.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) fell again on Thursday, off seven to a new post-1992 low of 1,038 points.
Ample tonnage weighed on the dry cargo freight market through to November.
Although there is a prospect that U.S. Gulf/Japan could ease to $18 short-term for want of grain orders, owners looked to non-grain Capesize business to pick up after the northern summer lull.

Coal fixtures reported on Thursday included Harriet Maru 170,000/10 tonnes Richards Bay/Rotterdam $5.25 fio scale/25,000c for 1-15 November to Cobelfret. Cape Cathy fixed 120,000 tonnes ore Tuburao option Sepetiba/Kaohsiung 25 October-10 November at $9.00 and $9.20 fio resp. 40,000/38,000c to China Steel.
Biffex futures were again lower with October down 28 at 1135 in volume of 164.
